topic: Auto-Dreamer Hugging Face publication chronology correction plus controlled fixed-bank evidence

public_sources.observed: Cached author activity surface was crawled about three months before this run and contains same-snapshot relative labels: Auto-Dreamer paper 2605.20616 'Published 1 day ago', RouteProfile 2605.00180 'Published 21 days ago', uyffg/auto-dreamer 'published a dataset 19 days ago', auto-dreamer-ckpt-bridge-public 'published a model 18 days ago', and dreamer_sciworld_v2_step60 'published a model 17 days ago'.
public_sources.scope: This is a cached historical snapshot, not a live Aug-2026-relative clock. Relative event labels must be interpreted relative to the snapshot time, not the present observation time.

public_sources.observed: Repository content history begins May 2 and ScienceWorld core trace uploads and evaluation-selection additions appear May 2-6. This chronology is consistent with the separately anchored cached activity snapshot.
Current dataset README reports ScienceWorld train/test rollout corpus counts 3,592/1,819 and three task taxonomies: 30 native task names, 11 functional groups, and 6 broad domains.

Paper fixed-bank regime gives each method an identical pre-built initial bank B0 constructed from a sampled trajectory pool through the same fixed writer, invokes consolidation exactly once where applicable, then evaluates a frozen task agent on a held-out set. On ScienceWorld Auto-Dreamer reports 44.3% SR and 539 active tokens versus strongest baseline Mem0 at 42.0% and 1,609 tokens. The paper's find-entity case study also holds task agent, writer, retriever, prompt format, and task order fixed: Auto-Dreamer 58/80 (72.5%), 13 entries/795 tokens, 7.4 steps per success versus AWM 21/80 (26.2%), 10 entries/816 tokens, 20.0 steps per success.

inference.hf_snapshot_anchor: The prior role-state interpretation that Hugging Face '19/18/17 days ago' publication labels were relative to the Aug-29 observation is incorrect. The page is a cached historical snapshot. Same-page paper labels anchor the snapshot to roughly late May 2026: Auto-Dreamer is 1 day old relative to its May-20 v1 while RouteProfile is 21 days old relative to its Apr-30 v1. Therefore the dataset/model publication events labeled 19/18/17 days ago fall in early May, before Auto-Dreamer v1, consistent with May 2-6 repository commit chronology. Exact Hub createdAt/private-to-public transition timing is still not established.
inference.paper_level_causal_scope: The fixed-bank regime is stronger than the continual aggregate for isolating the consolidation operator because B0, writer construction, and frozen task agent are controlled. The find-entity slice is additionally a matched online-stream comparison with near-identical final bank token footprint. These remain paper-level matched-method evidence; without serialized B0/B*, per-task outputs, source/checkpoint/run identity and verifier/environment binding they are not static replay certificates.
